WITH trader_agg AS (
    SELECT tr_anchor, 
           SUM(vol_day) as total_vol_day,
           MAX(trade_perf->>'lev_ratio')::numeric as max_lev_ratio
    FROM trade_records
    GROUP BY tr_anchor
),
high_risk AS (
    SELECT t.TR_KEY,
           t.typeFlag,
           REGEXP_REPLACE(t.trader_fin_data->>'usd_bal', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g')::numeric as balance,
           COALESCE(a.total_vol_day, 0) as daily_volume,
           COALESCE(a.max_lev_ratio, 0) as tle_score,
           CASE WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(t.trader_fin_data->>'usd_bal', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g')::numeric > 0 
                THEN COALESCE(a.total_vol_day, 0) / REGEXP_REPLACE(t.trader_fin_data->>'usd_bal', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g')::numeric
                ELSE 0 
           END as dtr_score
    FROM traders t
    LEFT JOIN trader_agg a ON t.TR_KEY = a.tr_anchor
    WHERE (COALESCE(a.max_lev_ratio, 0) > 5.0 AND t.trader_fin_data->>'risk_lvl' = 'Aggressive')
       OR (CASE WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(t.trader_fin_data->>'usd_bal', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g')::numeric > 0 
                THEN COALESCE(a.total_vol_day, 0) / REGEXP_REPLACE(t.trader_fin_data->>'usd_bal', '[^0-9.]', '', 'g')::numeric
                ELSE 0 END) > 0.5
)
SELECT * FROM high_risk ORDER BY TR_KEY LIMIT 10;
